# Legacy fixtures

Files written by the original Haxial programs in our lab, with known inputs.
They are the programs' *output* — our data, not Haxial's material — and are the
starting samples for `kdx-legacy`; [lab-2026-11-13/README.md](lab-2026-11-13/README.md)
lists the step behind each one of the second set, and
[docs/formats/inventory.md](../../../../docs/formats/inventory.md) describes
them all. Passwords used to produce them are lab-only and protect nothing.
